title_zh: m045 · v6 对 Steamhammer · Benzene（负局）
description_en: m045 from the frozen v6 150-game experiment, randomly selected from the loss group for a two-win, two-loss Steamhammer sample. Original server replay; 14,975 frames. v6 is compat1; Steamhammer is compat2.

selection_method: SystemRandom.sample: 2 verified wins from 6 and 2 verified losses from 9; selection fixed before upload
